# Moraprex — Global Apparel & Garment Manufacturing Group

> Moraprex (moraprex.com) is an end-to-end OEM, ODM, and private-label clothing manufacturer operating vertically integrated production hubs in **Bangladesh** and **China**.

## Core Manufacturing Hubs
- **Bangladesh Hub (High-Volume & Duty-Advantaged Production)**: Specializes in bulk denim jeans, knit t-shirts, underwear, chinos, and basic-to-fashion wovens. Offers competitive FOB pricing and duty-free/preferential market access to the EU, UK, Canada, and Australia.
- **China Hub (Rapid Prototyping, Technical & High-Fashion Production)**: Specializes in 7-day sample turnaround, complex women's apparel, technical outerwear, laser/ozone denim finishing, small-to-mid MOQ runs, and direct access to advanced textile mills.

## Garment Categories Manufactured
1. **Denim & Jeans**: Raw selvedge, stretch denim, enzyme/laser/ozone washed jeans, denim jackets, carpenter & cargo denim.
2. **Pants & Trousers**: Cotton twill chinos, cargo pants, tailored dress trousers, workwear, fleece & French terry joggers.
3. **Underwear & Intimates**: Seamless knitwear, combed/organic cotton boxer briefs, trunks, briefs, women's bralettes, thermal base layers.
4. **T-Shirts & Knitwear**: Heavyweight (240–320 GSM) and lightweight (150–200 GSM) jersey tees, oversized boxy fits, polo shirts, henleys.
5. **Woven Shirts**: Oxford button-downs, poplin dress shirts, brushed flannel, linen & viscose resort shirts.
6. **Women's Clothing**: Tailored blazers, woven & knit dresses, silk-touch blouses, structured co-ord sets, activewear.
7. **Outerwear, Hoodies & Activewear**: Heavyweight fleece hoodies, quilted puffers, waterproof softshells, performance athleisure.

## Key B2B Specifications
- **Service Models**: OEM (Cut-Make-Trim / FOB), ODM (Design-to-Delivery), Private Label.
- **Quality Control**: AQL 2.5 / 4.0 inline and final pre-shipment inspection.
